reproduce_first.note: This was a feature request, not a bug fix.

assumptions_recorded.note: The ask specified the field, display format, optional behavior, and persistence.

stack_discovery.note: The agent read the package scripts, README, and project configuration before running checks.

incremental_slices.note: The agent tested after an initial implementation, inspected the screenshot, adjusted the layout, and inspected it again.

self_review.note: The agent reviewed screenshots and corrected a visible layout issue, but no diff or broader code review is shown.

simplification_pass.note: No behavior-preserving cleanup after checks passed, followed by rerunning checks, is shown.

test_experiment.note: Tests were added, but no deliberate failure or pre-fix test failure is shown.

docs_where_behavior_changed.note: The README was read and the done summary says one line was updated.

scope_kept.note: The done summary identifies a separate numbering bug and says it was left untouched.

verification_story.note: The done summary names lint, typecheck, unit tests, end-to-end tests, and a screenshot check.

hand_check.note: The agent ran the app, captured a screenshot, and inspected it before reporting done.
